_comment: The ecosystem-wide user profile. Every field here must be product-neutral: it is asked once, on typhed.com, and read by every product. A field only one product needs belongs in that product's own table, or 'the account layer is shared' becomes 'everything behind a login lives here' within two quarters. storage says where a value is kept - 'column' is a real column on profile.user_profiles_mw, 'attribute' is a key inside its attributes jsonb. Adding an attribute field is a commit to this file with no migration; a field earns promotion to a column when it is filtered on, sorted on, read by another service, or needs a database constraint. The API rejects any key not listed here with a 422, which is what keeps the jsonb from becoming a dumping ground.
_thresholdComment: Fraction of total weight a profile must reach before it counts as complete. The crossing is stamped once into profile_completed_at and never recomputed, so adding a field below cannot un-complete an account that already finished. Bump schemaVersion when you genuinely do want to re-prompt everyone.
